token_preparation: Private consumed TokenBatch; at most1024 borrowed token/count pairs, total occurrences preserved before dedup, streaming tail unchanged. No persistent scratch retained by index.
mutation_paths: Normal insertion, prepared analyzers and cache restoration converge on existing prepared-insertion/statistics maintenance.
mcp_connection_lifetime: Private Session synchronizes closing/admission and owns existing tokio-util TaskTracker. Owned WorkerLease registers with the tracker when acquiring one global permit,before initialprogress awaits,then moves into blockingwork. Early drop/panic releases permit before tracking token. Shared semaphore remains admission-only;late reservations rejected.
optional_runtime_feature: mcp uses existing resolved tokio-util0.7.20 with explicit tested minimum/rt; Cargo.lock adds its futures-util edge,with no version upgrades.
